I got this feedback on this PR branch: The comment says this initializes a bare repo, but git.PlainInit(dir, false) creates a non-bare repository. Either change the flag to true or update the comment to avoid confusion about what’s being exercised here. 

for common_test.go:785

The comment says "bare repo" but `git.PlainInit(dir, false)` creates a non-bare repository. Since this test is about reading git config for commit author resolution (not about worktree behavior), a non-bare repo is fine — the comment just needs fixing.

input.old_string: // Create a bare repo to avoid worktree side effects
input.new_string: // Create a repo for config resolution
